title: The Expansion Deal Your CS Team Should Slow Down
excerpt: The customer wants to buy more. But the team doing the work isn't ready. Here's how to decide whether to go ahead, start smaller or wait.
primary_goal: Decide whether to proceed, phase or pause a proposed expansion by making delivery dependencies and the cost of waiting explicit.
primary_cta: Use the Expansion Decision Note on one live opportunity with the account owner and customer delivery lead.
playbook_description: A one-page guide to deciding whether to go ahead, start smaller or wait, with a simple example and a prompt to help you think it through.
